instruction: Configure LibreOffice Writer to use 1 inch margins (all sides) as the default for new documents

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default page margins for LibreOffice Writer to 1 inch on all sides (2540 twips = 1 inch). The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file to verify LeftMargin, RightMargin, TopMargin, and BottomMargin settings under StandardPageMode. Similar difficulty to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements in the instruction - all four margins (left, right, top, bottom) are checked
Getter extracts the correct LibreOffice config file where default page margin settings are persisted
Metric logic correctly parses XML with proper namespace handling and XPath queries
Expected value is semantically correct: 2540 twips = 1 inch
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses rules['margin_value'] without incorrect nested access
Returns 1 only when ALL four margins match expected value, ensuring complete verification
No postconfig needed since this is a persistent file-based configuration, not a temporary UI state
Edge cases handled appropriately: returns 0 if file not found or parsing fails
